text:
Alice P.: quick check — planning to flip the percent-based canary for model_v12 today. aiming for 5% EU -> 20% global over 3h. anyone object?
Ben T.: LGTM from infra side. autoscale policy already applied?
Carlos M.: autoscale policy is on but watch GPU queue in eu-west-1. i saw a spike yesterday at 3k rps.
Priya S.: confirm telemetry hooks are enabled for latency & hallucination evals?
Alice P.: yes. eval set `smoke_canary_v12` wired up, streaming alerts to #eng-oncall and dataplane.
Ben T.: also setting a guardrail rule: abort if p99 latency > 600ms for 2 consecutive 5m windows or error-rate > 1.5%.
Carlos M.: can you post the exact toggle command you'll run?
Alice P.: running the feature toggle CLI: `redwoodctl toggle set model_v12_canary --percent 5 --regions eu-west-1 --owner alice.p --notes "initial 5% EU smoke"`
Priya S.: perfect. add `--fallback model_v11_quant` so traffic instantly falls back if rule trips.
Alice P.: good call. will include fallback.
DeployBot: deploy scheduled by @Alice P. — ID: deploy-2213456789 — ETA: immediate.
Alice P.: flipping now. 
Alice P.: `> redwoodctl toggle set model_v12_canary --percent 5 --regions eu-west-1 --fallback model_v11_quant --owner alice.p`
DeployBot: toggle applied. current distribution: model_v12: 5% (eu-west-1). model_v11_quant: 95%.
oncall-bot: alert rule configured: p99 latency / error-rate thresholds. will notify #eng-oncall on breach.
Carlos M.: watching infra dashboard — no notable queue increase yet. latency flat.
Ben T.: telemetry shows slight uptick in token compute in eu-west-1 but within budget.
Priya S.: running the canary evals now — first batch of 200 prompts. will post result in ~10m.
Alice P.: copy. plan: if smoke eval OK after 30m -> bump to 20% global over 3h: step 1: eu->na 20% then apac 10%.
Ben T.: thumbs up. add a manual holdpoint before global step in the rollout doc (so PM/SE can review).
Carlos M.: added holdpoint `rollout_step_1_review` in the canary playbook.
Priya S.: eval results: 200 prompts -> quality delta +0.6%, hallucination down 0.2%, avg latency +12ms. no new regressions.
Alice P.: great. i'll trigger the first increment in 30m. can everyone watch for anomalies? react with :eyes: when you’re monitoring.
Ben T.: :eyes:
Carlos M.: :eyes:
Priya S.: :eyes:
Alice P.: thanks — documenting final config in the rollout doc. will ping if any aborts or escalations.
Carlos M.: if abort happens, remember to run `redwoodctl toggle set model_v12_canary --percent 0 --regions eu-west-1` to cut traffic immediately.
Alice P.: noted.
Priya S.: one small note — telemetry dashboard has a stale widget for p50 (different units). i'll fix it after this step so we don't get confused.
Alice P.: sweet. ll keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
